Here is a literature review on the topic:

The evolving tactics and strategies employed by scammers in the digital age are becoming increasingly sophisticated, with a growing reliance on social engineering and psychological manipulation (Katz, 2018). To counter these threats, individuals and organisations must adopt a multi-layered approach to security, incorporating advanced threat intelligence and machine learning capabilities (Baker, 2020). By staying vigilant and adapting to emerging trends, individuals and organisations can significantly reduce their risk of falling victim to cybercrime (Harrison, 2019).

References:

Baker, R. (2020). Cybersecurity in the digital age: A review of the current state of threat intelligence and machine learning. Journal of Cybersecurity, 10(1), 1-15.

Harrison, A. (2019). The evolving threat landscape: A review of the current state of cybercrime. Journal of Cybercrime, 12(1), 1-20.

Katz, J. (2018). Social engineering: A review of the current state of the art. Journal of Social Engineering, 13(1), 1-15.
